v.t: Kaf, Ha, Ya, Ayn, Saad
v.l: Kaf-Ha-Ya-`Ayn-Sad

v.t: A mention of the mercy of your Lord towards His servant Zechariah
v.l: Dhikru Rahmati Rabbika `Abdahu Zakariya

v.t: When he called on his Lord, a call in seclusion
v.l: Idh Nada Rabbahu Nida'an Khafiyaan

v.t: He said, “My Lord, my bones have become feeble, and my hair is aflame with gray, and never, Lord, have I been disappointed in my prayer to you
v.l: Qala Rabbi 'Inni Wahana Al-`Azmu Minni Wa Ashta`ala Ar-Ra'su Shaybaan Wa Lam 'Akun Bidu`a'ika Rabbi Shaqiyaan

v.t: “And I fear for my dependents after me, and my wife is barren. So grant me, from Yourself, an heir
v.l: Wa 'Inni Khiftu Al-Mawaliya Min Wara'i Wa Kanati Amra'ati `Aqiraan Fahab Li Min Ladunka Waliyaan

v.t: To inherit me, and inherit from the House of Jacob, and make him, my Lord, pleasing.”
v.l: Yarithuni Wa Yarithu Min 'Ali Ya`quba Wa Aj`alhu Rabbi Rađiyaan

v.t: “O Zechariah, We give you good news of a son, whose name is John, a name We have never given before.”
v.l: Ya Zakariya 'Inna Nubashiruka Bighulamin Asmuhu Yahya Lam Naj`al Lahu Min Qablu Samiyaan

v.t: He said, “My Lord, how can I have a son, when my wife is barren, and I have become decrepit with old age?”
v.l: Qala Rabbi 'Anna Yakunu Li Ghulamun Wa Kanat Amra'ati `Aqiraan Wa Qad Balaghtu Mina Al-Kibari `Itiyaan

v.t: He said, “It will be so, your Lord says, ‘it is easy for me, and I created you before, when you were nothing.’”
v.l: Qala Kadhalika Qala Rabbuka Huwa `Alayya Hayyinun Wa Qad Khalaqtuka Min Qablu Wa Lam Taku Shay'aan

v.t: He said, “My Lord, give me a sign.” He said, “Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights straight.”
v.l: Qala Rabbi Aj`al Li 'Ayatan Qala 'Ayatuka 'Alla Tukallima An-Nasa Thalatha Layalin Sawiyaan

v.t: And he came out to his people, from the sanctuary, and signaled to them to praise morning and evening
v.l: Fakharaja `Ala Qawmihi Mina Al-Mihrabi Fa'awha 'Ilayhim 'An Sabbihu Bukratan Wa `Ashiyaan

v.t: “O John, hold on to the Scripture firmly,” and We gave him wisdom in his youth
v.l: Ya Yahya Khudhi Al-Kitaba Biquwatin Wa 'Ataynahu Al-Hukma Sabiyaan

v.t: And tenderness from Us, and innocence. He was devout
v.l: Wa Hananaan Min Ladunna Wa Zakaatan Wa Kana Taqiyaan

v.t: And kind to his parents; and he was not a disobedient tyrant
v.l: Wa Barraan Biwalidayhi Wa Lam Yakun Jabbaraan `Asiyaan

v.t: And peace be upon him the day he was born, and the day he dies, and the Day he is raised alive
v.l: Wa Salamun `Alayhi Yawma Wulida Wa Yawma Yamutu Wa Yawma Yub`athu Hayyaan

v.t: And mention in the Scripture Mary, when she withdrew from her people to an eastern location
v.l: Wa Adhkur Fi Al-Kitabi Maryama 'Idh Antabadhat Min 'Ahliha Makanaan Sharqiyaan

v.t: She screened herself away from them, and We sent to her Our spirit, and He appeared to her as an immaculate human
v.l: Fattakhadhat Min Dunihim Hijabaan Fa'arsalna 'Ilayha Ruhana Fatamaththala Laha Basharaan Sawiyaan
w: then he assumed for her the likeness
then he assumed for her the likeness

v.t: She said, “I take refuge from you in the Most Merciful, should you be righteous.”
v.l: Qalat 'Inni 'A`udhu Bir-Rahmani Minka 'In Kunta Taqiyaan

v.t: He said, “I am only the messenger of your Lord, to give you the gift of a pure son.”
v.l: Qala 'Innama 'Ana Rasulu Rabbiki Li'haba Laki Ghulamaan Zakiyaan

v.t: She said, “How can I have a son, when no man has touched me, and I was never unchaste?”
v.l: Qalat 'Anna Yakunu Li Ghulamun Wa Lam Yamsasni Basharun Wa Lam 'Aku Baghiyaan

v.t: He said, “Thus said your Lord, `It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign for humanity, and a mercy from Us. It is a matter already decided.'“
v.l: Qala Kadhaliki Qala Rabbuki Huwa `Alayya Hayyinun Wa Linaj`alahu 'Ayatan Lilnnasi Wa Rahmatan Minna Wa Kana 'Amraan Maqđiyaan
w: and so that We will make him

v.t: So she carried him, and secluded herself with him in a remote place
v.l: Fahamalat/hu Fantabadhat Bihi Makanaan Qasiyaan

v.t: The labor-pains came upon her, by the trunk of a palm-tree. She said, “I wish I had died before this, and been completely forgotten.”
v.l: Fa'aja'aha Al-Makhađu 'Ila Jidh`i An-Nakhlati Qalat Ya Laytani Mittu Qabla Hadha Wa Kuntu Nasyaan Mansiyaan

v.t: Whereupon he called her from beneath her: “Do not worry; your Lord has placed a stream beneath you
v.l: Fanadaha Min Tahtiha 'Alla Tahzani Qad Ja`ala Rabbuki Tahtaki Sariyaan

v.t: And shake the trunk of the palm-tree towards you, and it will drop ripe dates by you.”
v.l: Wa Huzzi 'Ilayki Bijidh`i An-Nakhlati Tusaqit `Alayki Rutabaan Janiyaan

v.t: “So eat, and drink, and be consoled. And if you see any human, say, ‘I have vowed a fast to the Most Gracious, so I will not speak to any human today.'“
v.l: Fakuli Wa Ashrabi Wa Qarri `Aynaan Fa'imma Taraynna Mina Al-Bashari 'Ahadaan Faquli 'Inni Nadhartu Lilrrahmani Sawmaan Falan 'Ukallima Al-Yawma 'Insiyaan

v.t: Then she came to her people, carrying him. They said, “O Mary, you have done something terrible
v.l: Fa'atat Bihi Qawmaha Tahmiluhu Qalu Ya Maryamu Laqad Ji'ti Shay'aan Fariyaan

v.t: O sister of Aaron, your father was not an evil man, and your mother was not a whore.”
v.l: Ya 'Ukhta Haruna Ma Kana 'Abuki Amra'a Saw'in Wa Ma Kanat 'Ummuki Baghiyaan

v.t: So she pointed to him. They said, “How can we speak to an infant in the crib?”
v.l: Fa'asharat 'Ilayhi Qalu Kayfa Nukallimu Man Kana Fi Al-Mahdi Sabiyaan

v.t: He said, “I am the servant of God. He has given me the Scripture, and made me a prophet
v.l: Qala 'Inni `Abdu Allahi 'Ataniya Al-Kitaba Wa Ja`alani Nabiyaan

v.t: And has made me blessed wherever I may be; and has enjoined on me prayer and charity, so long as I live
v.l: Wa Ja`alani Mubarakaan 'Ayna Ma Kuntu Wa 'Awsani Bis-Salaati Wa Az-Zakaati Ma Dumtu Hayyaan

v.t: And kind to my mother, and He did not make me a disobedient rebel
v.l: Wa Barraan Biwalidati Wa Lam Yaj`alni Jabbaraan Shaqiyaan

v.t: So Peace is upon me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the Day I get resurrected alive.”
v.l: Wa As-Salamu `Alayya Yawma Wulidtu Wa Yawma 'Amutu Wa Yawma 'Ub`athu Hayyaan

v.t: That is Jesus son of Mary—the Word of truth about which they doubt
v.l: Dhalika `Isa Abnu Maryama Qawla Al-Haqqi Al-Ladhi Fihi Yamtaruna

v.t: It is not for God to have a child—glory be to Him. To have anything done, He says to it, “Be,” and it becomes
v.l: Ma Kana Lillahi 'An Yattakhidha Min Waladin Subhanahu 'Idha Qađa 'Amraan Fa'innama Yaqulu Lahu Kun Fayakunu

v.t: “God is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path.”
v.l: Wa 'Inna Allaha Rabbi Wa Rabbukum Fa`buduhu Hadha Siratun Mustaqimun

v.t: But the various factions differed among themselves. So woe to those who disbelieve from the scene of a tremendous Day
v.l: Fakhtalafa Al-'Ahzabu Min Baynihim Fawaylun Lilladhina Kafaru Min Mash/hadi Yawmin `Azimin

v.t: Listen to them and watch for them the Day they come to Us. But the wrongdoers today are completely lost
v.l: Asmi` Bihim Wa 'Absir Yawma Ya'tunana Lakini Az-Zalimuna Al-Yawma Fi Đalalin Mubinin

v.t: And warn them of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded. Yet they are heedless, and they do not believe
v.l: Wa 'Andhirhum Yawma Al-Hasrati 'Idh Quđiya Al-'Amru Wa Hum Fi Ghaflatin Wa Hum La Yu'uminuna

v.t: It is We who will inherit the earth and everyone on it, and to Us they will be returned
v.l: Inna Nahnu Narithu Al-'Arđa Wa Man `Alayha Wa 'Ilayna Yurja`una

v.t: And mention in the Scripture Abraham. He was a man of truth, a prophet
v.l: Wa Adhkur Fi Al-Kitabi 'Ibrahima 'Innahu Kana Siddiqaan Nabiyaan

v.t: He said to his father, “O my father, why do you worship what can neither hear, nor see, nor benefit you in any way
v.l: Idh Qala Li'abihi Ya 'Abati Lima Ta`budu Ma La Yasma`u Wa La Yubsiru Wa La Yughni `Anka Shay'aan

v.t: O my father, there has come to me knowledge that never came to you. So follow me, and I will guide you along a straight way
v.l: Ya 'Abati 'Inni Qad Ja'ani Mina Al-`Ilmi Ma Lam Ya'tika Fa Attabi`ni 'Ahdika Sirataan Sawiyaan

v.t: O my father, do not worship the devil. The devil is disobedient to the Most Gracious
v.l: Ya 'Abati La Ta`budi Ash-Shaytana 'Inna Ash-Shaytana Kana Lilrrahmani `Asiyaan

v.t: O my father, I fear that a punishment from the Most Gracious will afflict you, and you become an ally of the devil.”
v.l: Ya 'Abati 'Inni 'Akhafu 'An Yamassaka `Adhabun Mina Ar-Rahmani Fatakuna Lilshaytani Waliyaan

v.t: He said, “Are you renouncing my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will stone you. So leave me alone for a while.”
v.l: Qala 'Araghibun 'Anta `An 'Alihati Ya 'Ibrahimu La'in Lam Tantahi La'arjumannaka Wa Ahjurni Maliyaan

v.t: He said, “Peace be upon you. I will ask my Lord to forgive you; He has been Kind to me
v.l: Qala Salamun `Alayka Sa'astaghfiru Laka Rabbi 'Innahu Kana Bi Hafiyaan

v.t: And I will withdraw from you, and from what you pray to instead of God. And I will pray to my Lord, and I hope I will not be disappointed in my prayer to my Lord.”
v.l: Wa 'A`tazilukum Wa Ma Tad`una Min Duni Allahi Wa 'Ad`u Rabbi `Asa 'Alla 'Akuna Bidu`a'i Rabbi Shaqiyaan

v.t: When he withdrew from them, and from what they worship besides God, We granted him Isaac and Jacob. And each We made a prophet
v.l: Falamma A`tazalahum Wa Ma Ya`buduna Min Duni Allahi Wahabna Lahu 'Ishaqa Wa Ya`quba Wa Kulla Ja`alna Nabiyaan

v.t: And We gave them freely of Our mercy, and gave them a noble reputation of truth
v.l: Wa Wahabna Lahum Min Rahmatina Wa Ja`alna Lahum Lisana Sidqin `Aliyaan

v.t: And mention in the Scripture Moses. He was dedicated. He was a messenger and a prophet
v.l: Wa Adhkur Fi Al-Kitabi Musa 'Innahu Kana Mukhlasaan Wa Kana Rasulaan Nabiyaan

v.t: And We called him from the right side of the Mount, and brought him near in communion
v.l: Wa Nadaynahu Min Janibi At-Turi Al-'Aymani Wa Qarrabnahu Najiyaan

v.t: And We granted him, out of Our mercy, his brother Aaron, a prophet
v.l: Wa Wahabna Lahu Min Rahmatina 'Akhahu Haruna Nabiyaan

v.t: And mention in the Scripture Ishmael. He was true to his promise, and was a messenger, a prophet
v.l: Wa Adhkur Fi Al-Kitabi 'Isma`ila 'Innahu Kana Sadiqa Al-Wa`di Wa Kana Rasulaan Nabiyaan

v.t: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and charity, and he was pleasing to his Lord
v.l: Wa Kana Ya'muru 'Ahlahu Bis-Salaati Wa Az-Zakaati Wa Kana `Inda Rabbihi Marđiyaan

v.t: And mention in the Scripture Enoch. He was a man of truth, a prophet
v.l: Wa Adhkur Fi Al-Kitabi 'Idrisa 'Innahu Kana Siddiqaan Nabiyaan

v.t: And We raised him to a high position
v.l: Wa Rafa`nahu Makanaan `Aliyaan

v.t: These are some of the prophets God has blessed, from the descendants of Adam, and from those We carried with Noah, and from the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and from those We guided and selected. Whenever the revelations of the Most Gracious are recited to them, they would fall down, prostrating and weeping
v.l: Ula'ika Al-Ladhina 'An`ama Allahu `Alayhim Mina An-Nabiyina Min Dhurriyati 'Adama Wa Mimman Hamalna Ma`a Nuhin Wa Min Dhurriyati 'Ibrahima Wa 'Isra'ila Wa Mimman Hadayna Wa Ajtabayna 'Idha Tutla `Alayhim 'Ayatu Ar-Rahmani Kharru Sujjadaan Wa Bukiyaan

v.t: But they were succeeded by generations who lost the prayers and followed their appetites. They will meet perdition
v.l: Fakhalafa Min Ba`dihim Khalfun 'Ađa`u As-Salaata Wa Attaba`u Ash-Shahawati Fasawfa Yalqawna Ghayyaan

v.t: Except for those who repent, and believe, and act righteously. These will enter Paradise, and will not be wronged in the least
v.l: Illa Man Taba Wa 'Amana Wa `Amila Salihaan Fa'ula'ika Yadkhuluna Al-Jannata Wa La Yuzlamuna Shay'aan

v.t: The Gardens of Eden, promised by the Most Merciful to His servants in the Unseen. His promise will certainly come true
v.l: Jannati `Adnin Allati Wa`ada Ar-Rahmanu `Ibadahu Bil-Ghaybi 'Innahu Kana Wa`duhu Ma'tiyaan

v.t: They will hear no nonsense therein, but only peace. And they will have their provision therein, morning and evening
v.l: La Yasma`una Fiha Laghwan 'Illa Salamaan Wa Lahum Rizquhum Fiha Bukratan Wa `Ashiyaan

v.t: Such is Paradise which We will give as inheritance to those of Our servants who are devout
v.l: Tilka Al-Jannatu Allati Nurithu Min `Ibadina Man Kana Taqiyaan

v.t: “We do not descend except by the command of your Lord. His is what is before us, and what is behind us, and what is between them. Your Lord is never forgetful.”
v.l: Wa Ma Natanazzalu 'Illa Bi'amri Rabbika Lahu Ma Bayna 'Aydina Wa Ma Khalfana Wa Ma Bayna Dhalika Wa Ma Kana Rabbuka Nasiyaan

v.t: Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them. So worship Him, and persevere in His service. Do you know of anyone equal to Him
v.l: Rabbu As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Wa Ma Baynahuma Fa`bud/hu Wa Astabir Li`ibadatihi Hal Ta`lamu Lahu Samiyaan

v.t: And the human being says, “When I am dead, will I be brought back alive?”
v.l: Wa Yaqulu Al-'Insanu 'A'idha Ma Mittu Lasawfa 'Ukhraju Hayyaan

v.t: Does the human being not remember that We created him before, when he was nothing
v.l: Awala Yadhkuru Al-'Insanu 'Anna Khalaqnahu Min Qablu Wa Lam Yaku Shay'aan

v.t: By your Lord, We will round them up, and the devils, then We will bring them around Hell, on their knees
v.l: Fawarabbika Lanahshurannahum Wa Ash-Shayatina Thumma Lanuhđirannahum Hawla Jahannama Jithiyaan

v.t: Then, out of every sect, We will snatch those most defiant to the Most Merciful
v.l: Thumma Lananzi`anna Min Kulli Shi`atin 'Ayyuhum 'Ashaddu `Ala Ar-Rahmani `Itiyaan

v.t: We are fully aware of those most deserving to scorch in it
v.l: Thumma Lanahnu 'A`lamu Bial-Ladhina Hum 'Awla Biha Siliyaan

v.t: There is not one of you but will go down to it. This has been an unavoidable decree of your Lord
v.l: Wa 'In Minkum 'Illa Wa Ariduha Kana `Ala Rabbika Hatmaan Maqđiyaan

v.t: Then We will rescue those who were devout, and leave the wrongdoers in it, on their knees
v.l: Thumma Nunajji Al-Ladhina Attaqaw Wa Nadharu Az-Zalimina Fiha Jithiyaan

v.t: When Our clear revelations are recited to them, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, “Which of the two parties is better in position, and superior in influence?”
v.l: Wa 'Idha Tutla `Alayhim 'Ayatuna Bayyinatin Qala Al-Ladhina Kafaru Lilladhina 'Amanu 'Ayyu Al-Fariqayni Khayrun Maqamaan Wa 'Ahsanu Nadiyaan

v.t: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, who surpassed them in riches and splendor
v.l: Wa Kam 'Ahlakna Qablahum Min Qarnin Hum 'Ahsanu 'Athathaan Wa Ri'yaan

v.t: Say, “Whoever is in error, the Most Merciful will lead him on.” Until, when they see what they were promised—either the punishment, or the Hour. Then they will know who was in worse position and weaker in forces
v.l: Qul Man Kana Fi Ađ-Đalalati Falyamdud Lahu Ar-Rahmanu Maddaan Hatta 'Idha Ra'aw Ma Yu`aduna 'Imma Al-`Adhaba Wa 'Imma As-Sa`ata Fasaya`lamuna Man Huwa Sharrun Makanaan Wa 'Ađ`afu Jundaan

v.t: God increases in guidance those who accept guidance. And the things that endure—the righteous deeds—have the best reward with your Lord, and the best outcome
v.l: Wa Yazidu Allahu Al-Ladhina Ahtadaw Hudaan Wa Al-Baqiyatu As-Salihatu Khayrun `Inda Rabbika Thawabaan Wa Khayrun Maraddaan

v.t: Have you seen him who denied Our revelations, and said, “I will be given wealth and children”
v.l: Afara'ayta Al-Ladhi Kafara Bi'ayatina Wa Qala La'utayanna Malaan Wa Waladaan

v.t: Did he look into the future, or did he receive a promise from the Most Merciful
v.l: Attala`a Al-Ghayba 'Am Attakhadha `Inda Ar-Rahmani `Ahdaan

v.t: No indeed! We will write what he says, and will keep extending the agony for him
v.l: Kalla Sanaktubu Ma Yaqulu Wa Namuddu Lahu Mina Al-`Adhabi Maddaan

v.t: Then We will inherit from him what he speaks of, and he will come to Us alone
v.l: Wa Narithuhu Ma Yaqulu Wa Ya'tina Fardaan
w: and he will come to Us

v.t: And they took, besides God, other gods, to be for them a source of strength
v.l: Wa Attakhadhu Min Duni Allahi 'Alihatan Liyakunu Lahum `Izzaan

v.t: By no means! They will reject their worship of them, and become opponents to them
v.l: Kalla Sayakfuruna Bi`ibadatihim Wa Yakununa `Alayhim Điddaan

v.t: Have you not considered how We dispatch the devils against the disbelievers, exciting them with incitement
v.l: Alam Tara 'Anna 'Arsalna Ash-Shayatina `Ala Al-Kafirina Ta'uuzzuhum 'Azzaan

v.t: So do not hurry against them. We are counting for them a countdown
v.l: Fala Ta`jal `Alayhim 'Innama Na`uddu Lahum `Addaan

v.t: On the Day when We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful, as guests
v.l: Yawma Nahshuru Al-Muttaqina 'Ila Ar-Rahmani Wafdaan

v.t: And herd the sinners into hell, like animals to water
v.l: Wa Nasuqu Al-Mujrimina 'Ila Jahannama Wirdaan

v.t: They will have no power of intercession, except for someone who has an agreement with the Most Merciful
v.l: La Yamlikuna Ash-Shafa`ata 'Illa Mani Attakhadha `Inda Ar-Rahmani `Ahdaan

v.t: And they say, “The Most Merciful has begotten a son.”
v.l: Wa Qalu Attakhadha Ar-Rahmanu Waladaan

v.t: You have come up with something monstrous
v.l: Laqad Ji'tum Shay'aan 'Iddaan

v.t: At which the heavens almost rupture, and the earth splits, and the mountains fall and crumble
v.l: Takadu As-Samawatu Yatafattarna Minhu Wa Tanshaqqu Al-'Arđu Wa Takhirru Al-Jibalu Haddaan

v.t: Because they attribute a son to the Most Merciful
v.l: An Da`aw Lilrrahmani Waladaan

v.t: It is not fitting for the Most Merciful to have a son
v.l: Wa Ma Yanbaghi Lilrrahmani 'An Yattakhidha Waladaan

v.t: There is none in the heavens and the earth but will come to the Most Merciful as a servant
v.l: In Kullu Man Fi As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi 'Illa 'Ati Ar-Rahmani `Abdaan

v.t: He has enumerated them, and counted them one by one
v.l: Laqad 'Ahsahum Wa `Addahum `Addaan

v.t: And each one of them will come to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone
v.l: Wa Kulluhum 'Atihi Yawma Al-Qiyamati Fardaan

v.t: Those who believe and do righteous deeds, the Most Merciful will give them love
v.l: Inna Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa `Amilu As-Salihati Sayaj`alu Lahumu Ar-Rahmanu Wuddaan

v.t: We made it easy in your tongue, in order to deliver good news to the righteous, and to warn with it a hostile people
v.l: Fa'innama Yassarnahu Bilisanika Litubashira Bihi Al-Muttaqina Wa Tundhira Bihi Qawmaan Luddaan
w: that you may give glad tidings

v.t: How many a generation have We destroyed before them? Can you feel a single one of them, or hear from them the slightest whisper
v.l: Wa Kam 'Ahlakna Qablahum Min Qarnin Hal Tuhissu Minhum Min 'Ahadin 'Aw Tasma`u Lahum Rikzaan
